name: EXM_TRAVEL_DATA_VAL_RULES
description: This table contains information about validation rules to be applied to travel itineraries upon import. A validation rule determines which attribute will be validated and against which table or lookup code type value.

columns.name: VALIDATION_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Travel itinerary validation rule set that contains this rule.

columns.name: VALIDATION_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Unique name identifier of the travel itinerary validation rule.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether rule is enabled.

columns.name: VALIDATION_TYPE
columns.description: Validation Type for this rule.  Value of TABLE means to validate itinerary attribute against the table name stored in SOURCE_NAME column. Value of LOOKUP means to validate itinerary attribute against the lookup type stored in SOURCE_NAME column. TCA means to validate itinerary attribute against Oracle Trading Community Architecture tables. Value of HR means to validate itinerary attribute against Oracle Human Resources tables. Value of NOT NULL means to validate that itinerary attribute value is not null.

columns.name: SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Source name of the Trading Community Architecture table, Expenses lookup or Expenses table used to validate against.
